operator-session.readWrite: Sensitive System paths require authenticated JWT or machine CLI token even if requireLogin=false.

password-confirmed-system.readWrite: /api/settings/database additionally verifies the supplied dashboard password inside handler, for export and import. No invented user-role permission.

dashboard-configurable.readWrite: General dashboard middleware allows valid CLI token or authenticated session; requireLogin=false allows this class without login. This differs from admin ABI and always-protected System mutations.

notification-config.write: Handler canWriteNotifications requires valid CLI token, valid dashboard JWT or local request; merely disabling login does not authorize a remote write.

public-read.read: Version metadata is on middleware public allowlist. Reading /api/version may contact npm unless disabled or cached.

inference.readWrite: Outer public-LLM middleware requires loopback, valid machine CLI token or valid remote client API key. Handlers independently enforce supplied key validity, requireApiKey when configured, model allowlists and applicable budget admission.
inference.budgetBoundary: Several nonchat modalities explicitly refuse limited keys when durable dispatch coverage is unsupported; Embeddings and Rerank use durable attempt trackers. Do not promise uniform budget support.

inference-discovery.read: Voice list relies on the outer inference middleware; it has no separate handler requireApiKey/model-allowlist enforcement. Its loopback self-call uses machine CLI token.
